title: 第532章 喜羊羊，你想杀了村长吗？
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“灰太狼，你还是出来了！”

看到林远抱着沸羊羊，扛着喜羊羊，在巨型炮筒上坐着的喜羊羊收起了喇叭。

美羊羊微微皱眉，将手中点燃的蜡烛轻轻吹灭了。

林远终于知道为什么喜羊羊有自信说一大利炮能炸死他们了。

因为仅是炮筒的洞口，都能容下一百个暖羊羊了。

更何况，里面炮弹的威力呢？

林远面无表情道：

“喜羊羊，我能问你一个问题吗？”

喜羊羊低头看了眼站在引线旁的美羊羊，后者已经熄灭了蜡烛。

“好，灰太狼。”

“只限一个问题，回答之后，你就放了沸羊羊和懒羊羊。”

林远点了点头。

“喜羊羊，你想杀死......慢羊羊吗？”

闻言，喋喋不休的沸羊羊停止了说话，站在引线旁的美羊羊抬起了头，装睡的懒羊羊也睁开了一只眼睛，偷偷地看着喜羊羊。

喜羊羊也被林远的话吓了一跳。

“灰太狼，你什么意思？”

“村长可是抚养了我们这么多羊，我怎么会做那种事？”

林远眯了眯眼：

“我要你回答，想与不想。”

既然慢羊羊杀死了青青草原那么多生物，作为羊村最聪明的喜羊羊，应该早就察觉了慢羊羊的不对劲吧？

即使喜羊羊是诡异......也不会任凭这种事继续下去吧。

喜羊羊的表情有些惊疑不定。

“不......不想。”

林远讪讪地笑了：

“回答的这么艰难吗。”

他将视线移到了美羊羊身上。

此时的美羊羊刚刚松了口气，并未注意到。

林远淡淡道：

“美羊羊，喜羊羊回答了我的问题，我可以放一只羊。”

“你是要放沸羊羊，还是懒羊羊？”

睁开一只眼的懒羊羊又装睡了过去。

沸羊羊眼巴巴地看向了美羊羊。

“美羊羊，懒羊羊平时好吃懒做你也知道的，我回羊村才是利益最大化啊！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Big Big Wolf, you still came out!"

Seeing Lin Yuan holding the Boiling Goat and carrying the Pleasant Goat, the Pleasant Goat sitting on the giant cannon put away its horn.

Meiyangyang frowned slightly and gently blew out the lit candle in her hand.

Lin Yuan finally understood why Pleasant Goat was confident that a big cannon could blow them up.

Because the hole in the barrel alone can accommodate a hundred warm sheep.

What's more, what's the power of the shells inside?

Lin Yuan said expressionlessly:

"Pleasant Goat, can I ask you a question?"

Pleasant Goat lowered his head and glanced at Beautiful Goat standing next to the lead, who had already extinguished the candle.

"Okay, Big Big Wolf."

"Only one question. After answering, you let the Boiling Sheep and the Lazy Sheep go."

Lin Yuan nodded.

"Pleasant Goat, do you want to kill...Slow Sheep?"

Hearing this, the chattering Boiling Goat stopped talking, the Beautiful Goat standing by the lead raised his head, and the Lazy Goat who was pretending to sleep also opened one eye and secretly looked at the Pleasant Goat.

Pleasant Goat was also shocked by Lin Yuan's words.

"Big Big Wolf, what do you mean?"

"The village chief has raised so many of our sheep, how could I do something like that?"

Lin Yuan narrowed his eyes:

"I want you to answer, whether you want it or not."

Since Slow Sheep has killed so many creatures in Qingqing Grassland, as the smartest Pleasant Goat in Yangcun, he should have noticed something was wrong with Slow Sheep, right?

Even if Pleasant Goat is weird... he won't let this kind of thing continue.

Pleasant Goat's expression was a little uncertain.

"No...don't want to."

Lin Yuan smiled sarcastically:

"Is it so difficult to answer?"

He moved his gaze to Meiyangyang.

At this time, Meiyangyang just breathed a sigh of relief and did not notice.

Lin Yuan said calmly:

"Beautiful Sheep, Pleasant Sheep answered my question, I can herd a sheep."

"Are you going to herd the Boiling Sheep or the Lazy Sheep?"

Lazy Sheep opened one eye and pretended to sleep again.

Boiling Yangyang looked at Beautiful Yangyang eagerly.

"Beautiful Yangyang, you know that Lazy Yangyang usually eats well and is lazy to cook. I will maximize my profits by returning to Yangcun!"
